artefact_file: test_data/evtx/TA0001-Initial access/T1078-Valid accounts/ID33205-SQL Server failed login with disabled SA account.evtx
scenario_prompt: Analyze these Windows event logs for signs of unauthorized access attempts against a SQL Server instance. Identify the targeted account, source of the attack, and nature of the failed logins. Use only evidence present in the data.

expected_findings.indicator: Event ID 33205: SQL Server failed login attempts for user 'sa'
expected_findings.explanation: Multiple failed login attempts targeting the 'sa' (system administrator) account, which is disabled, indicating a brute-force or credential stuffing attack.
All failed login attempts originated from client IP 10.23.23.9, identifying the attack source.
The attacker targeted the default SQL Server 'sa' account, which is disabled, resulting in password evaluation errors.

notes: Easy case: only 2 events, clear SQL Server authentication failure pattern. Single event type (33205) with obvious brute-force indicator against disabled sa account.
